meta_title: Fix Up Look Sharp | Painter & Decorator Bristol
meta_description: Fix Up Look Sharp is your trusted painter and decorator in Bristol. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting that transforms your home. Honest pricing, reliable timescales, pristine finish every time.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Bristol
services_subhead: From bedroom refreshes to full commercial repaints, we handle every surface with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork and feature finishes for every room. We prepare surfaces properly and use premium paints for a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paints and rendering work to protect and refresh your home's façade. Fully weather-sealed and guaranteed against peeling.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert wallpaper installation and careful removal of old coverings without damage. We match patterns perfectly and leave no bubbles or seams.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, architraves and fitted furniture painted to a professional standard. All surfaces sanded smooth and finished with durable lacquer.

services.title: Commercial & Office Repainting
services.desc: Fast, efficient repaints for shops, offices and rental properties. We work around your schedule and leave sites spotless.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Works
services.desc: Proper prep is everything. We fill cracks, sand surfaces, strip old paint and prime correctly—no shortcuts, no shortcuts.

about_pullquote: We do the job right first time, so you never have to worry.
about_para_1: Fix Up Look Sharp was founded in 2009 by decorators frustrated with sloppy workmanship and hidden costs. We started with one van and a commitment to honest pricing and clean work. Today we're one of Bristol's most trusted painting teams, with a reputation built on turning up on time, finishing on time, and leaving your home looking brilliant.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat every job—whether it's a small bedroom or a full commercial repaint—with the same care and professionalism. We invest in quality materials, take pride in preparation, and don't cut corners. That's why 9 in 10 of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Needed our whole lounge redecorating before Christmas. Fixed Up Look Sharp came out, gave a fair quote, and got it done in three days. Absolutely brilliant—no mess, no faffing about, and looks fantastic. Will 100% use them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had the exterior of our Victorian terrace painted. They took real care preparing the surfaces and matching the original sash window frames. Took longer than some quotes but the finish is worth every penny. Proper craftsmen.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency living room repaint after water damage. They came out same day, quoted fairly, and finished next morning. Very professional, friendly lads. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Paul W.
